name: Rear Foot Elevated Split Squat
instructions: Stand a couple of feet in front of a bench and place your back foot on it, laces down.
Lower your back knee toward the floor by bending your front knee.
Keep your torso upright and your front foot flat.
Drive through your front foot to stand.
longevityNotes: Single-leg strength and balance are what keep you steady on uneven ground and stairs. Lunge work trains the stability that prevents the falls that change lives.
overview: A split squat with the back foot on a bench that trains the quads and glutes one side at a time.

safetyNotes: Start with bodyweight; stop with knee pain.
